title: Educational Workshop English Castle
markdown:
Empowering the Next Generation of STEM Educators in Morocco !

Our today's workshop at English Castle Center - Bouskoura was a true milestone in teacher development:

“Teaching in English – Succeeding in STEM Classrooms & Job Interviews”.

Co-led by international experts **Ms. Julie Wilburn (AGI)** and **Ms. Nadya Eve Mezeli** (TEFL Expert), alongside our Executive Director **Mr. Noureddine Khizani.**

This high-impact session welcomed Master's & PhD holders for the Faculté des sciences Ben M'Sik looking to thrive in CLIL/EMI environments.

![](https://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/505755848_10234198183087780_2197829503939970428_n-240x300.jpg)

![🔍](https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tc1/1/16/1f50d.png) What participants gained:

![🔹](https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tf3/1/16/1f539.png) Proven strategies for teaching STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Maths) in English.

![🔹](https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tf3/1/16/1f539.png) Interview prep for local & international schools

![🔹](https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tf3/1/16/1f539.png) Insight into Anglia STEM teachers' certifications

![🔹](https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/tf3/1/16/1f539.png) CLIL/EMI demo lesson

Special thanks to Mrs. Sanaa EL FIlALI (Faculté des sciences Ben M'Sik) for her continued trust and partnership with English Castle.

Attendees will connect with recruiters and discover real teaching opportunities!

![➡️](https://static.xx.fbcdn.net/images/emoji.php/v9/t9e/1/16/27a1.png) Morocco’s future STEM teachers are ready to lead — and English Castle Center - AGI and Anglia Examinations are proud to support them every step of the way.

Please reach out if AGI and Anglia Examinations can help you make an impact in your community.
